measured: 2026-10-29, sokol-lab (Lima vz, aarch64, Ubuntu 24.04, glibc 2.39), release build of this change

notes.all_bounds: One table with every bound full: 262144 own claims with 512-byte reasons, 262144 retraction and lease records, 65536 event ids and strikes, 65536 targets with 8 reasons each. rss_kb is the process's VmRSS growth over the fill in a fresh test process.
notes.take_and_serialize_ms: take_persisted plus serde_json::to_vec; take_persisted runs under the table lock in submit_state.
notes.save_state_ms: The state writer thread: serialize, write, fsync, rename, fsync of the directory.
notes.mesh floor: A (u64, u64) pair at its widest: 2 x 20 digits, brackets, comma and separator.
notes.replay_guard_bytes_per_peer: ADR-0013: about 40 bytes x 70000 nonces of a peer at its frame limit; analytic, not measured.
notes.eviction_margin: Signals past the larger count bound in the saturation, so every node evicts and the run can check that it did.
